subject: SIG questionnaire - playbook notification & escalation clarifications
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@greenbank.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: GreenBank Security Team <security@greenbank.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: incident notification playbook follow-ups

Diego,

Thanks for sending the SIG draft. Our questionnaire team needs succinct answers for the incident response section so we can move this into procurement. A few short clarifying questions: 

1) Notification timelines: do you have both an initial acknowledgement SLA and a committed timeline for notifying impacted customers? Please include business-hours vs 24x7 distinctions if they apply.

2) Regulator involvement: under what circumstances would Redwood notify a regulator directly versus deferring to the customer? Any historical examples are helpful.

3) Named contacts vs role-based: for SIG we prefer role-based addresses, but can accept named escalations. Please confirm which you prefer and provide emails.

4) Evidence handoff: expected turnaround for triage bundles and how chain-of-custody is recorded.

5) Contractual notice windows: do you accept 72-hour notice clauses or other typical redlines?

We'd like short bullets we can paste into the SIG answer bank. Can we do a 30-minute call later today or early next week?

Best,
Megan Liu
Senior Security Analyst
GreenBank Financial
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@greenbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, GreenBank Security Team <security@greenbank.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: incident notification playbook follow-ups

Megan,

Appreciate the clear list. Below are concise answers you can drop into the SIG. Attaching our playbook excerpt and an evidence matrix for reference. Laura and Karthik are cc'd for legal/contract context.

- Initial acknowledgement: incidents@redwood.ai will acknowledge confirmed incidents within 4 business hours of internal confirmation; this inbox is monitored 24x7 and triggers the on-call rotation.

- Customer notification: Redwood will notify the affected customer within 24 hours of confirming a customer-impacting incident. 'Confirming' means validated evidence of unauthorized access or data exfiltration tied to customer data.

- Interim and final reports: Redwood provides an interim incident report within 72 hours when reasonably practicable and a complete post-incident report within 10 business days for typical incidents; complex investigations may require more time and we provide updates as the investigation progresses.

- Regulator notification: Redwood does not routinely notify regulators on behalf of customers. Direct regulator notifications occur only when required by law, mandated by contract, or by explicit mutual agreement. Historically, Redwood has engaged regulators directly in a small number of cases where jurisdictional law required it.

- Contacts (preferred model): role-based for operations, named for escalations: incidents@redwood.ai (triage), Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai> (incident lead), Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> (legal escalation), ciso@redwood.ai (executive escalation).

- Evidence handling: triage evidence bundle typically delivered within 3 business days of an investigation hold; deeper forensic exports up to 10 business days depending on scope. Chain-of-custody is recorded in our evidence matrix; artifacts are hash-verified and timestamped.

- Contractual notice windows: standard practice is to accept 72-hour initial notification clauses for enterprise contracts and to negotiate regulator-notify-by-customer language by default. Any SLA credits or regulator commitments are discussed case-by-case.

If you'd like, we can join a 30-minute call to map this language into your SIG fields. We're available Fri 16th 10:00 AM PT or Mon 19th 2:00 PM PT.

Regards,
Diego Fernandez
Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
(Attachment: Redwood_Incident_Playbook_v2.pdf)
(Attachment: SIG_evidence_matrix.xlsx)

Hi Megan,

Short answers you can paste into the SIG: 

- Notification timing (paste): 'Redwood will notify the affected customer within 24 hours of confirming a customer-impacting security incident, and will provide an interim report within 72 hours when reasonably practicable.'

- Evidence metadata (paste): 'Redwood provides triage evidence bundles that include artifact metadata with cryptographic hashes and timestamps; chain-of-custody is recorded in our evidence matrix.'

Historical regulator note (paste): 'Redwood does not routinely notify regulators on behalf of customers; direct notifications have only occurred where required by law or contract.'

We are comfortable with these short lines for SIG consumption. If your procurement wants softer language (e.g., add 'reasonable efforts' or 'where applicable') we can provide a one-line redline.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
